# ffuf

`ffuf` &middot; _web-applications_

A fast web fuzzer for directories, parameters and virtual hosts.

**Moderate impact.** It touches the target directly; keep the scope tight.

## What this tool needs

- A URL containing the word FUZZ where fuzzing should happen.
- A wordlist (the runtime ships common wordlists).

## How to use it

Put FUZZ where the word should go, e.g. https://example.com/FUZZ. Add `-mc 200,301,302` to filter to interesting status codes. Fuzzing is high volume; only run it against systems in scope.

## Examples

```console
$ ffuf -u https://example.com/FUZZ -w /usr/share/wordlists/dirb/common.txt -mc 200,301,302
```

## At a glance

- Category: `web-applications`
- Install with: `apt install ffuf`
- Baseline: yes
